༄༅/ /gsung mgur gyi thog ma lcam skal ldan la gnang ba sogs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gsung mgur gyi thog ma lcam skal ldan la gnang ba sogs bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru// pha bka' drin can la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal ba dus kyi tha ma la// rje khyed kyi thugs rjes bzung du gsol| |sems can bsod nams dman pa'i dus// rje khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bstan pa yar gyi ngo bzhin du// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /mnar med dmyal ba stong pa dang*// yi dwags bkres skom zhi bar shog dud 'gro glen lkugs dang bral zhing*// sems can sangs rgyas thob par shog /skal ldan dga' skyid dpal 'dzoms shing*// bkra shis don chen 'grub par shog /ces pa lcam skal ldan bzang mos yab chos kyi rgyal po la gsol 'debs mgur ma zhig mdzod gsungs par dgong lo bdun gyi thog tu phul// ༈ //rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don du ni// thugs rje chen pos dbyings nas gzigs// e ma 'gro la brtse bar mdzod// a la la nyams kyi dga' ba la// a ha rang gzhan don 'grub shog /ces pa mtshungs med dam pa dkon mchog rin chen gyis/ da lta sa la ma sdod par mgur ma zhig gyis gsungs par/ 'bri rwas rang lo brgyad kyi thog tu phul// ༈ //yang zhu lan mgur ma/ chos sku'i ston pa bla ma 'od dpag med// longs sku'i ston pa bla ma spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku'i ston pa bla ma pad+ma 'byung*| |bla ma de gsum la gsol btab bya bral nga'i dga' ba// 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma rat+na dang*// bka' drin 'khor med chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs// gtan gyi skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog gsum// skyabs gnas de gsum la zhu ba'i dkon mchog nga skyid do// jo jo 'jam dbyangs ltar mkhas pa rdo rje'i gar dbang*// jo jo spyan ras gzigs gnyis pa dkon mchog ni rin chen// jo jo gsang bdag ltar mthu chen bkra shis ni phun tshogs// jo bo gsum gyi drin la 'bri rwa nga skyid do// bdag gi yi dam gtso bo 'khor lo yi bde mchog /lhag pa'i lha mchog tshe bdag ni gshin rje// yi dam de gsum la zhu ba'i bya bral nga blo bde// gza' dang ma mo rdo rje dang legs pa// kun dga' gzhon nu gnod sbyin gyi rtsi dmar// 'di rnams bya bral nga yi las mkhan de yin no// ha ha/

rje btsun bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon// skyes mchog khyod kyi bka' ma chog/ 'brel med gang dran bris pa dang*// yul ngo sdug pas lag pa 'khob| |dgun khar song bas snag tsha 'khyag /thos rgya chung bas sdeb ma shes// zhu lan 'gyang bar dgongs ma khrel// 'brug lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes grangs bzang po bco lnga'i nyin/ mtshungs med dkon mchog rin chen gyi bka' lung la khyod kyi bla ma su yin/ yi dam gtso bo gang byed/ bka' srung drag rtsal can ci 'dra yod gsungs pa'i lan du phul ba'o// ༈ /dkon cog rin chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phun tshogs ci bsam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// pad+ma 'byung gnas rje btsun rat+na dang*// chos kyi rgyal pos rtag tu dge bar mdzod// log 'dren bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba dang*// 'dzam gling ma lus dbang du sdud par byed// sangs rgyas bstan pa yar gyi ngo bzhin spel// sde brgyad mtha' dmag ma lus nga yis bcom// dga' bas don 'grub skyid tshul ngag nas thon// gling bzhi kun tu grags pa'i bkra shis shog /dga' mo rang shog shog /rten 'brel ni bzang bzang*/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin/ rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs su rdo pa drung chos pa'i nyang bro glu gzhas sogs byas par brten/ nyams 'bar gyi tshul du dgung lo dgu'i thog tu phul ba'o// ༈ /pad 'byung sna tshogs rang grol zhabs// bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'di phyi kun tu dge ba dang*// log pa'i lam la mi 'gro bar// don gnyis mtha' ru phyin par shog /ces rin chen lhas sbyin gyis gsol 'debs mgur ma zhig dgos zhes par pho lo bcu gcig gi thog tu byin pa'o// ༈ /rgyal ba sras bcas gcig tu bsdus pa yi// ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rat+na shrī'i mtshan 'dzin bla ma de| |spyi bo'i gtsug tu mi 'bral brtan par bzhugs// thog ma'i kun bzang zhes pa'i sgra skad can// gang nas ma byung gang du'ang mi 'gro ste// bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun ma lus khyab| |ma bcos ma spros bcos bslad bral ba na// sangs rgyas bla ma logs su ma mchis te// kun mkhyen 'di gar thams cad tshang bar go// sems la bcos bslad bral ba kun tu bzang*| |de las ma 'gag gsal snang longs spyod rdzogs// rig pa'i rgyal po rang snang 'od gsal ngang*// sgyu ma'i snang brnyan 'char ba sprul sku ste// sku gsum ston pa'ang de rang min pa su| |rdo rje 'chang dang shāka thub 'jig rten mgon// dus gsum sangs rgyas bya ba'i skad po che/

bcos bslad bral na dkon mchog gsum po yang*// rang la 'dug pa ngo mtshar mi che'am| |de ltar yin gyi grogs mchog dam pa yang*// dug lnga dug gsum legs nyes skyid sdug kun// lam du 'khyer ba 'di ni gdams pas na// sangs rgyas byang sems dpang po bcol ba yis// sgrub pa'i snying po gangs dkar ti ser mdzod// gsol ba snying nas thob dang 'bral thabs med// ces chos mdzad 'phrang bu pa ri bor sgrub pa la 'gro bar/ khyod rang sku mched dran dus dang*/ skyid sdug ci la'ang phan pa zhig dgos zer bas rang lo bco lnga'i thog tu byin pa'o// ༈ /e ma hoḥ spros bral chos sku snang ba mtha' yas mchog /'dzin med ston pa 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog /'gag med sprul sku pad+ma rgyal po mchog /rang sems dag pa mchog gsum bla mar 'dud// rkang gnyis gtso bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog /zhi chags bral ba brgyad khri bzhi stong mchog /tshogs gnyis zhing gyur 'phags pa'i dge 'dun mchog /gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la 'dud// bstan pa'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen nas| |rtsa ba'i bla ma chos rgyal phun tshogs yan// brgyud bzang chu bo sum sgril thugs rje can// 'khrul med grub thob brgyud par gus pas 'dud// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul khri srong lde'u btsan// spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs// gsang ba'i bdag po mnga' bdag khri yi mtshan// rigs gsum sprul pa chos rgyal gsum la 'dud// yi dam kun 'dus 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /dbang gi rgyal po khro rgyal rta mchog dpal// rdo rje phag mo yum dang mnyam par sbyor// byang chub ma thob bar du byin chen phob// lus la 'gyur med sku yi byin chen phob// ngag la tshangs dbyangs gsung gi byin chen phob// sems la spros bral thugs kyi byin chen phob// dbang bzhi sku bzhi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// gu ru pad+ma gnam lcags me 'bar gyi// bka' yi dam la gnas pa'i mthu rtsal can// smug nag lcam dral bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan// lus grib bzhin du bsgrub phyir da 'brongs shig
/'di ni lag dal du bris te/ thal dpon ma gcig mgon la byin// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
